layout_rules.sidebar: Fixed, 260px width, sleek border-r border-white/10, bg-zinc-950, high contrast active states for navigation.
layout_rules.content_area: Padding p-8 or p-12, flex-col with gap-8, max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_rules.form_sections: Cardless or flat border-only surfaces. Use robust vertical containers with 1px border-white/10 and sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to feel like an industrial dashboard.

component_guidelines.checkboxes: Square, sharp edges, neon blue when checked. Organized in multi-column grids for options.
component_guidelines.condition_bar: A 5-step horizontal segmented bar. When a segment is selected, it lights up in its respective color (Red to Green) while others stay muted.
component_guidelines.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary: bg-[#0ea5e9] text-white hover:bg-[#0284c7]. Secondary: border border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-800.
component_guidelines.tables: Dense, sleek, border-collapse style. border-b border-zinc-800 for rows.

motion.hover: Subtle border color transition to border-zinc-500, slight brightness increase.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade in and slide up (10px) for form sections and lists.

appraisal_form.structure: Sidebar with scroll-spy navigation links. Multi-section form: Client Info (Nom, Prénom, Téléphone, Email), Vehicle Info (VIN with auto-decode mockup), Options (Checkboxes grid), Condition (Color bar: Mauvais to Excellent), Windshield State, Warranties, Photos upload grid, Notes.
appraisal_form.behavior: Scrollspy for sidebar to highlight active section. Form sections should be stacked with ample spacing (gap-12).

admin_dashboard.structure: Login page with auth_background. Evaluations list table with Search/Filter by VIN/Client. Evaluation Detail view with Status management badges.
admin_dashboard.behavior: Status management badges (e.g., Pending, Appraised, Rejected). Smooth row highlighting on hover.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI extensively. Force Tailwind dark mode globally.
Implement the Condition color bar (Mauvais, Faible, Moyen, Bon, Excellent) using segmented clickable divs that change color dynamically.
Create a detailed Options Checkbox section (e.g., Navigation, Toit ouvrant, Cuir, Sièges chauffants, etc.).
Implement a mock VIN Decoder input that auto-fills vehicle details when clicked.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for a high-tech automotive feel.
Build the multi-section form as one continuous scrollable page with a sticky sidebar for navigation.
For photos, build a slick grid upload area.
